content.title: About
content.content: Lemon pie filling is a ready‑to‑use filling made from lemon juice, sugar, eggs and starch, designed for quick preparation of lemon pies and tarts. It has a bright sweet‑tart flavor, smooth creamy texture and a pale yellow color.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The filling is a key component of the classic American Key Lime Pie.
Recipes often include real lemon juice and zest for authentic aroma.
Starch such as corn starch or pectin is added to stabilize the texture.
It can be used beyond pies, for example as a filling for cupcakes, profiteroles or dessert sandwiches.
Gluten‑free versions replace wheat starch with potato or tapioca starch.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Lemon juice provides vitamin C, an antioxidant that supports the immune system.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: The acidity of lemon can stimulate gastric juice production, helping digestion.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The filling typically contains no added fats, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Lemons supply potassium, which is important for blood pressure regulation.

items.title: Natural antibacterial properties
items.content: Lemon juice has mild antibacterial effects that help preserve freshness.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to lemons.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The product contains added sugar, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain commercial versions may contain preservatives; choose preservative‑free options if you are sensitive.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Pour the filling into a pre‑baked crust and bake until set, or chill it and use as a cold filling. It pairs well with meringue, whipped cream and fresh berries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at 2‑4 °C in a sealed container for up to 7 days. Once opened, consume within 3‑4 days. Discard if off‑smell or color changes.
